page_note: Heavily damaged page (96.8%) treating the dragon-image as a correspondential teaching. Structure: (a) polemical setup citing Magousaean cosmology (segs 0-2), (b) disciple's substantive question framed by dialogue formulae (segs 3-6), (c) Apostle's polemical refutation of the Magousaean reading (segs 7-14), (d) the true teaching: dragon → seven sense-organs of the body (segs 15-27). The substrate teaching is the seven-fold correspondence dragon↔head/sense organs↔body parts; this maps cosmos→anthropos within the system. The polemical frame and dragon-as-Magousaean-teaching is editorial. Severe lacunae make many calls provisional. Editorial fatigue score is strongly negative (polemic concentrates in first half, substrate emerges in second half) — consistent with polemical setup → core teaching pattern.
